nova-3.pricingNotes: Nova-3 Monolingual pre-recorded pay-as-you-go costs $0.0043/min ($0.258/hour). Speaker diarization is included for pre-recorded audio, so disabling it does not reduce the rate. Streaming rates and promotional rates do not apply. Discounts, taxes and credits are excluded.

limits.notes: Deepgram's current docs publish a 2 GB file cap and separately state no limits to audio length for batch transcription, with a 10-minute processing-time cap for Nova/Base/Enhanced requests.
